title_zh: 9月房价降幅缩小，一线城市继续上涨
title_en: September home-price declines narrow as first-tier cities keep rising

paragraphs.zh: 10月19日，国家统计局公布了9月份70个大中城市的房价数据，和去年同期相比，各类城市的房价虽然还在下降，但是降幅都变小了。从环比看，一线城市的新房价格比8月份继续上涨。
paragraphs.en: On October 19, the National Bureau of Statistics released September home-price data for 70 large and medium-sized cities. Compared with the same period last year, prices in all types of cities are still falling, but the declines have all become smaller. Month on month, new-home prices in first-tier cities kept rising from August.

paragraphs.zh: 具体来看，一线城市新房价格同比下降0.5%，降幅比8月份收窄了0.4个百分点。其中，上海新房价格上涨了2.8%，北京下降了2.7%。二线和三线城市的新房价格分别下降了2.4%和3.9%。
paragraphs.en: Specifically, new-home prices in first-tier cities fell 0.5% year on year, a decline 0.4 percentage points smaller than in August. Among them, Shanghai's new-home prices rose 2.8%, while Beijing's fell 2.7%. New-home prices in second- and third-tier cities fell 2.4% and 3.9% respectively.

paragraphs.zh: 二手房市场也一样：一线城市二手房价格同比下降1.5%，降幅收窄了1.2个百分点，上海还上涨了0.8%。
paragraphs.en: The second-hand housing market was the same: resale prices in first-tier cities fell 1.5% year on year, with the decline narrowing by 1.2 percentage points, and Shanghai even saw a 0.8% rise.

paragraphs.zh: 房地产是中国经济很重要的一部分，和银行贷款、居民财富的关系都很密切。
paragraphs.en: Real estate is a very important part of China's economy and is closely tied to bank loans and household wealth.

featured.en: year-on-year (compared with the same period last year)
featured.note: almost always before a verb of change: 同比增长 / 同比下降 / 同比上涨. Its partner is 环比 (compared with the previous month or quarter).

examples.zh: 9月份一线城市新房价格同比下降0.5%。
examples.py: Jiǔ yuèfèn yīxiàn chéngshì xīnfáng jiàgé tóngbǐ xiàjiàng bǎi fēn zhī líng diǎn wǔ.
examples.en: In September, new-home prices in first-tier cities fell 0.5% year on year.

examples.zh: 这家公司三季度的收入同比增长了百分之十五。
examples.py: Zhè jiā gōngsī sān jìdù de shōurù tóngbǐ zēngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī shíwǔ.
examples.en: This company's third-quarter revenue grew 15% year on year.

examples.zh: 我这个月的电费同比少了一半，因为今年夏天不太热。
examples.py: Wǒ zhège yuè de diànfèi tóngbǐ shǎo le yíbàn, yīnwèi jīnnián xiàtiān bú tài rè.
examples.en: My electricity bill this month is half what it was a year ago, because this summer wasn't very hot.

featured.en: to rise, go up (prices, values, water levels)
featured.note: 价格上涨 / 房价上涨 / 股价上涨 / 上涨了X%. Opposite: 下降、下跌. Compare 上调 (to raise deliberately, e.g. 上调利率).

examples.zh: 上海新房价格同比上涨了2.8%。
examples.py: Shànghǎi xīnfáng jiàgé tóngbǐ shàngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī èr diǎn bā.
examples.en: Shanghai's new-home prices rose 2.8% year on year.

examples.zh: 受好消息影响，这只股票今天上涨了百分之五。
examples.py: Shòu hǎo xiāoxi yǐngxiǎng, zhè zhī gǔpiào jīntiān shàngzhǎng le bǎi fēn zhī wǔ.
examples.en: Boosted by good news, this stock rose 5% today.

examples.zh: 最近水果价格上涨了，一斤苹果要十块钱。
examples.py: Zuìjìn shuǐguǒ jiàgé shàngzhǎng le, yì jīn píngguǒ yào shí kuài qián.
examples.en: Fruit prices have gone up lately; a jin of apples costs ten yuan.
